app.title: Quotify operator console
app.demo: Demo mode: sample data, a mock payment provider, mail goes to the local mail catcher. Nothing here is real.

signIn.title: Operator console
signIn.intro: Reads and acts through the gateway only. The token stays in this browser tab (session storage).

discrepancy.paid_without_charge: Paid, no charge in the ledger

jobs.title: Replay and re-rating jobs
jobs.hint: Look a job up by id (start them with quotifyctl or the admin API).

share.title: Share with the customer
share.hint: A link that shows this invoice and its PDF without signing in. Anyone who has it can open the invoice; it stops working when it expires or is revoked.
share.revoked: Every link to this invoice has been revoked.
share.badDays: Days: a whole number from 1 to 365.

payment.offlineHint: Record money received outside Quotify (a transfer, cash, other). A partial amount is allowed: the invoice is paid when the payments add up to the total.
payment.transferHint: Confirm what arrived on the bank statement. A partial amount is recorded and the invoice is paid when the transfers add up to the total.
payment.amountHint: Defaults to what is outstanding ({outstanding}). More than that is refused.
payment.referenceHint: Optional. The same reference again is treated as the same payment.
payment.bankReferenceHint: The bank's transaction or statement reference. Required: it makes a repeat harmless.
payment.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, more than zero, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.
payment.badDate: The received date must be a valid date and time, not in the future.

toast.duplicate: This payment had already been recorded.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.rejectHint: Use this when the customer's transfer was refused or will not come. The invoice is not paid and the tenant's dunning schedule applies at once: a new payment window, or uncollectible when no retry is left. Receipts already recorded stay.
transfer.expireHint: Use this when the payment window is over without the money. The invoice is not paid and the tenant's dunning schedule applies at once: a new payment window, or uncollectible when no retry is left. Receipts already recorded stay.
transfer.expiredNote: The payment window ended without the full amount. Dunning applies.
transfer.rejectedNote: The transfer was rejected. Dunning applies.

deadLetters.title: Dead letters
deadLetters.intro: RabbitMQ dead-letter queues ({pattern}). A message lands here after its delivery limit; redrive sends it back with the retry counter reset.
deadLetters.confirm: Move {count} dead letter(s) of {queue} back to {queue}? Their retry counters are reset.

playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: Walk through the whole product in a sandbox: create an account, define what is metered and priced, send usage, close the period and watch the invoice go through its payment saga with a mock payment provider. Nothing here touches a live tenant.

setup.title: 2. What is metered and priced
setup.button: Create meter, plan, customer and subscription

close.title: 4. Close the period
close.hint: Billing runs as at month end; the sandbox just moves the cutoff to now.

invoice.title: 5. Invoice
invoice.waiting: Waiting for the billing run (about 40 seconds)…

log.title: Done so far
log.version: Plan version: 10.00 base fee + 0.01 per call

packages.intro: Publishing a package that exists adds a new version. A version is fixed once published; subscriptions keep the version they started on.
packages.name: Name
packages.addFee: Add a fee in another currency
packages.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.
packages.interval: Billing interval of the extra fee
packages.tenantMonthly: The monthly fee in {currency} is the fixed fee above.

subscriptions.providerRuns: {provider} runs this subscription: renewals and retries are its. Change it there; it can be moved to another provider below.
subscriptions.changePlanHint: The change takes effect now. This month's fixed fee is split between the two packages by the time on each.
subscriptions.moveHint: The old subscription ends only when the new one takes over, so the customer is never billed by both.
subscriptions.checkoutReady: The customer subscribes here; the move completes when the provider confirms:
subscriptions.moved: Moved: the new subscription takes over where the old one ends.
subscriptions.noLimits: This package sets no usage limits.

change.title: Change plan or interval
change.auto: When: by direction of the change
change.atEnd: At the end of the paid period
change.creditAdded: {amount} is added to the credit balance

providerRun.title: Run by {provider}
providerRun.hint: These actions are made at the provider; Quotify's copy follows when the provider's notification arrives. A change is billed by the provider and applies at once.
providerRun.none: No proration: billed from the next renewal
providerRun.atPeriodEnd: Pause at the end of the paid period
providerRun.requested: Requested. This page updates when the provider confirms.

subscriptions.endNowCredit: End now and credit the unused part
subscriptions.confirmEndCredit: End this subscription now and credit the customer with the unused part of the fee they paid in advance?

payments.reconcileHint: Compares the invoices billing calls paid in a period with the successful charges the providers reported.
payments.summary: {paid} paid invoice(s) and {charges} successful charge(s) in the ledger.
payments.agree: The invoices and the ledger agree.
payments.truncated: Only the first discrepancies are listed; the counts above are complete.

providers.accountsHint: The tenant's own accounts at payment providers. Credentials are sealed when saved and never shown again.
providers.makeDefault: Live charges go here by default
providers.webhookHint: The provider sends its notifications to {path} on the gateway's public address.
providers.badJson: The settings are not valid JSON.
providers.routingHint: The first rule that matches a customer's country and the subscription's currency chooses the provider of a new subscription. No match: the default account. Existing subscriptions stay where they are.
providers.noRules: No rules: every new subscription goes to the default account.
providers.cannotCharge: That provider cannot charge in this currency.
providers.goesToDefault: No rule matches: the default account.
providers.noProviderSubscriptions: No subscription is run by a provider yet.

catalogue.title: Catalogue at the provider
catalogue.hint: Makes the provider hold a package, so it can be sold and changed there: its product once, and a price for every interval and currency the version has a fee in. Syncing twice changes nothing.
catalogue.empty: Nothing has been created at this provider yet.

bank.title: Bank transfer account
bank.sandboxNote: Sandbox charges never reach this provider (the mock payment provider handles them). Save the account in live to use it.
bank.ibanHint: Spaces and dashes are removed and the letters upper-cased; the check digits are verified.
bank.referenceHint: What the customer writes on the transfer. {number} and {id} are available; the default is the invoice number.
bank.currenciesHint: The currencies this account receives. None ticked: every currency.
bank.windowHint: How long to wait for the money, 0 to 90. 0 or empty uses the deployment default.

errors.format: An IBAN is two letters, two digits, then letters and digits.
errors.checksum: The check digits do not match: look for a typo.
errors.badBic: A BIC has 8 or 11 letters and digits.
errors.badTemplate: Only {number} and {id} may appear in braces.
errors.badWindow: A whole number of days from 0 to 90.

reports.revenueHint: Each currency has its own rows: amounts in different currencies are never added together.
reports.subscriptionsHint: Counted at the last instant of the month. Monthly recurring revenue is the fixed fees of active and past due subscriptions. A plan change or a provider move is neither new nor churn.
reports.dunningHint: Invoices whose payment was declined and is being retried, whose outcome is unknown, or that were given up.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.hint: A coupon takes a percentage or an amount off the fixed fee Quotify invoices in advance: once, for a number of periods, or for as long as the subscription lasts. A subscription run by a provider uses a discount at the provider instead.
coupons.name: Name
coupons.badPercent: Not a percentage: 0.01 to 100 with at most two decimals.
coupons.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.

tax.title: Tax
tax.hint: Quotify adds these rates on top of the price to the invoices it raises, by the customer's country (the rate without a country covers all others). You set the rates and are responsible for them; an invoice a provider issues is taxed by the provider.
tax.name: Name {n}
tax.badRate: Not a percentage: 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.

dunning.title: Payment retries
dunning.hint: When a charge is declined, Quotify tries again after each delay below, then gives the invoice up as uncollectible. Delays are in hours (minutes in a sandbox account).
dunning.defaults: You have not set any: the standard delays are shown.
dunning.none: No retries: a declined charge is given up at once.
dunning.bad: Each delay is a whole number from 1 to 720.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: Quotify sends a signed JSON POST to these HTTPS endpoints when something happens in the account: an invoice is paid, a credit note is issued, a subscription changes. Verify the Quotify-Signature header with the endpoint's secret; failed deliveries are retried for about a day and a half.
webhooks.eventsHint: Tick none to receive every event.
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now: it is shown only once.
webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete this endpoint and its delivery history?

paymentLinks.title: Payment links
paymentLinks.hint: A link the customer opens without signing in to pay. For an open invoice, or ad hoc for a fixed amount (the invoice is made when the customer first uses it). Anyone who has the link can pay; it stops working when it expires or is revoked.
paymentLinks.adhocHint: The invoice is made, and numbered, when the customer presses Continue on the page.
paymentLinks.invoiceHint: The invoice must be finalized and unpaid.
paymentLinks.shownOnce: Copy the link now: it is shown once and cannot be read back.
paymentLinks.replayed: This request was already handled: the link exists, but its address is shown only once.
paymentLinks.confirmRevoke: Revoke this link? Unpaid invoices made from it are voided.

errors.amount: Enter a positive amount with the currency's decimals.
errors.description: Say what the payment is for.
errors.days: Days: a whole number from 1 to 365.

portal.title: Payment page of {id}
portal.hint: A link to a page where this customer sees their invoices and payments, downloads PDFs and receipts, and pays what is open. Read-only.
portal.revoked: Every payment page link of this customer has been revoked.
portal.confirmRevoke: Revoke every payment page link of this customer?

mail.title: E-mail
mail.hint: Choose which kinds of e-mail Quotify sends to this tenant's customers. A kind that is switched off is dropped, not queued: switching it on again does not send what was skipped.

descriptions.invoice_issued: Tells the customer that a new invoice was finalized.
descriptions.payment_receipts: The receipt after a successful payment.
descriptions.payment_failed: A failed payment, a retry and the notice that Quotify gave up collecting.
descriptions.usage_alerts: A customer passed a usage limit of its plan.

mail.providerNote: A payment provider that sends its own receipts (Paddle) keeps sending them; this switch only controls Quotify's mail.

packs.hint: A pack is a number of credits sold for a price. A customer buys it with a payment link; the credits are added when the payment is confirmed.
packs.name: Pack name
packs.title: Credit packs

grant.expiryHint: Leave empty for credits that never expire

purchase.title: Purchase link
purchase.hint: A link the customer opens to buy this pack. When the payment is confirmed the credits are added once. The price is always the pack's.
purchase.shownOnce: Copy the link now: it is shown once and cannot be read back.

settings.title: Low-balance alert
settings.hint: When a customer's balance drops below this number, Quotify sends the credits.low webhook event once. 0 turns it off.

einvoice.title: E-invoice
einvoice.confirmCancel: Cancel this legal e-document? This cannot be undone.

settings.title: E-invoicing
settings.hint: Turn invoices and credit notes into legal e-documents (e-fatura, e-arşiv, Peppol) sent through your integrator. The company data below is printed on every document.

account.title: Integrator account
account.hint: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again. The sandbox environment can only use the mock provider.
account.sandboxHint: The sandbox always uses the mock provider: documents are accepted with a fake legal number.
account.neverShown: The secret is sent once and cannot be read back.

account.missing: The tenant has no e-invoice account for this environment.
account.invalid: The e-invoice account settings are not valid.
account.sandbox_mock_only: The sandbox environment can only use the mock provider.

seller.incomplete: The company legal data (name, tax id) is incomplete.

buyer.incomplete: The customer's tax data is incomplete.

document.not_failed: Only a failed e-document can be retried.
document.not_issued: Only an issued e-document can be cancelled.

cancel.unsupported: This provider cannot cancel the document.

file.not_ready: The file is not available yet.

provider.unavailable: The integrator could not be reached; it will be tried again.

setting.invalid: The e-invoice setting is not valid.

customer.tax_invalid: The customer's tax data is not valid.

apps.hint: An app is one of the account's applications, with its own sandbox and live environment, keys, customers and plans. Currency, time zone and grace period are chosen here and cannot be changed later.
apps.name: App name
apps.badSlug: The slug may only have lower-case letters, digits and single dashes, at most 60 characters.
apps.title: Apps of this account
apps.immutable: Renaming and deleting an app is not available in the API yet; an app's currency, time zone and grace period cannot be changed.
apps.empty: This account has no apps yet.

keys.title: API keys of {app}
keys.hint: Create a key for one environment. The key is shown once; the API cannot list keys later, so keys made on this page are listed here until you leave it. A key from elsewhere can be revoked by its id.
keys.secretOnce: Copy the key now: it is shown only once.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke this API key? Requests using it stop working immediately.

address.title: Seller address
address.hint: The legal and billing address of this tenant, printed as the seller on every invoice (PDF and hosted page). It applies to invoices made after you save.

problems.oneLine: Must be one line of text.

address.postalHint: This does not look like a postal code of that country, for example {example}. It is accepted anyway.

preview.title: Invoice preview
preview.hint: How the seller appears on an invoice.
preview.empty: No address: the invoice shows only the name.

credit_note.bad_amount: The credit amount is not valid: it must be more than zero and no more than what is left to credit on the invoice.
credit_note.fully_credited: This invoice has already been credited in full.
credit_note.not_paid: Only a paid invoice can be credited.
credit_note.nothing_to_refund: There is nothing to refund to the card for this credit note.
credit_note.refund_not_failed: Only a credit note whose refund failed can be retried.

dunning.bad_delay: Each retry delay must be between 1 and 720 hours.
dunning.too_many_retries: At most 6 retry delays can be set.

invoice.pdf_not_ready: The invoice PDF has not been rendered yet. Try again in a moment.

invoice_link.bad_expiry: The link must expire in 1 to 365 days.
invoice_link.draft_invoice: A draft invoice cannot be shared by link.
invoice_link.not_found: The invoice link was not found.

payment.amount_mismatch: The payment is not for the amount of the invoice.
payment.invoice_not_payable: Only an open or uncollectible invoice can be paid by hand.
payment.bad_method: The method must be bank transfer, cash or other.
payment.bad_amount: The amount must be a whole number of minor units above zero.
payment.bad_date: The received date is not valid or lies in the future.
payment.overpayment: That is more than is outstanding. Record only the outstanding amount.
payment.not_payable: The invoice's payment state does not allow a manual payment right now.
payment.reference_reused: This reference was already recorded with a different amount.

payment_link.bad_amount: The amount must be a positive number of minor units.
payment_link.bad_description: A description is required, at most 200 characters.
payment_link.bad_key: The idempotency key is too long (at most 200 characters).
payment_link.bad_kind: Amount, currency, description and customer belong to an ad-hoc link; an invoice link takes them from the invoice.
payment_link.bad_page: The page size must be 1 to 200.
payment_link.bad_status: The status must be active, paid, expired or revoked.
payment_link.consumed: This link has already been used.
payment_link.idempotency_conflict: This idempotency key was used for a different payment link.
payment_link.invoice_not_payable: A paid or void invoice needs no payment link.
payment_link.invoice_required: A payment link of kind invoice needs an invoice.
payment_link.not_found: There is no such payment link.
payment_link.customer_required: A credit pack link needs the customer who receives the credits.
payment_link.pack_required: A credit pack link needs a pack.

credits.bad_amount: The amount must be a whole number of credits above zero.
credits.bad_expiry: The expiry date must lie in the future.
credits.bad_key: The idempotency key is too long (at most 128 characters).
credits.bad_pack: A pack needs a name and credits and a price above zero.
credits.bad_page_token: The page token is not valid.
credits.bad_reason: The note is too long (at most 200 characters).
credits.bad_source: The type must be promotion or manual.
credits.insufficient: The customer has too few credits.
credits.key_required: An idempotency key is required to spend credits.
credits.key_reused: This idempotency key was already used for a different request.
credits.pack_not_found: There is no such credit pack.
credits.bad_threshold: The threshold must be 0 or a whole number of credits.
credits.bad_validity: The validity must be 1 to 3650 days, or empty for credits that never expire.
credits.pack_inactive: This credit pack is not on sale.
credits.portal_cannot_buy: This portal link cannot buy credits. Ask for a new one.

app.bad_slug: The app slug may only have lower-case letters, digits and single dashes, and at most 60 characters.
app.slug_taken: This account already has an app with that slug.

mail.unknown_category: This mail category does not exist.

subscription.coupon_blocks_credit: This subscription has a coupon. Credit the unused part with a credit note on its fee invoice instead.

webhook.not_configured: Webhooks are not set up on this deployment (the secrets key is missing).
webhook.too_many_endpoints: The limit of webhook endpoints is reached. Delete one first.

customer.tax_invalid: The customer's tax id or tax office is not valid.

common.invalid_argument: Something in the request is not valid.
common.failed_precondition: This cannot be done in the current state.
common.permission_denied: You are not allowed to do this.
common.unauthenticated: Sign in again: the token is missing or no longer valid.
common.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
common.unavailable: The service is not available right now. Try again shortly.
common.timeout: The request took too long. Try again.
common.conflict: The data changed while you were working on it. Reload and try again.
common.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, and if it keeps failing look at the logs with the request id.

transfer.not_a_transfer: This invoice was not charged by bank transfer. Use Record payment instead.
transfer.invoice_closed: The invoice is already paid or void.
transfer.bad_amount: The amount must be a whole number of minor units above zero.
transfer.bad_currency: The currency differs from the invoice's.
transfer.overpayment: That is more than is outstanding. Record only the outstanding amount and handle the rest outside Quotify.
transfer.reference_reused: This bank reference was already recorded with a different amount.
transfer.bad_reference: The bank reference is missing or not valid.
transfer.bad_note: The note is too long (at most 500 characters).
transfer.bad_date: The received date is not valid or lies in the future.
transfer.nothing_pending: There is no pending transfer to reject.
transfer.bad_outcome: The outcome must be rejected or expired.
transfer.unavailable: The payments service is not available right now. Try again in a moment.

account.invalid: The e-invoice account settings are not valid for this provider.
account.missing: This tenant has no e-invoice account for this environment. Set one up first.
account.sandbox_mock_only: A sandbox environment can only use the mock e-invoice provider.

buyer.incomplete: The customer's tax data is incomplete: add the tax id (and tax office in Turkey) before issuing an e-invoice.

cancel.unsupported: This provider cannot cancel an issued e-invoice. Issue a credit note instead.

document.not_failed: Only an e-document that failed can be retried.
document.not_issued: Only an issued e-document can be cancelled.

file.not_ready: The file of this e-document is not available yet.

provider.rejected: The e-invoice provider rejected the document.
provider.unavailable: The e-invoice provider is not reachable right now. It will be tried again.

seller.incomplete: The seller's company data is incomplete: add the legal name and tax id in the e-invoice settings.

setting.invalid: The e-invoice trigger must be off, finalized or paid.
